issues.detail: The Greek 'δυναμενω' is a present active participle (or potentiality) modifying the action of supporting/strengthening. The Vietnamese 'nguyền xin Đấng có quyền' (I pray/beg that the One who has power) introduces an external deity and a prayerful request that is not present in the Greek text. The Greek 'δυναμενω' functions as 'able to' or 'empowering' in relation to the speaker's ability to strengthen them.
